title: The perfect words of Allah
cue: What to say in the evening for protection from harm
arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatillaahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq
translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 2709: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/6814

usage.evidence: A man stung by a scorpion came to the Prophet ﷺ, who said: had you said this when evening came, it would not have harmed you (Muslim 2709).
